title: Alpha Body, Beta Mind
description:
*Note: please consult a medical professional before starting a new exercise program.

Your Gym Girl Goddess created a session for all betas to enjoy. Don’t worry, “beta” is a term of endearment here. There’s no humiliation or body shaming in this workout.
And I just love submissive betas that I can control, mold and shape. The stronger and hotter you get, the more you become mine.
I want all of my followers to be sexy and gorgeous- and no matter how hot and strong you get, you’ll always be my beta. My soft-brained, submissive little toy.
You’re my empty-headed sex object, and you have an obligation to be hot.
I’ll be giving you my best encouragement to keep going, reminding you that you’re mine, you’re transforming, and this is all so good for you. You’ll even get a few kisses to keep you going. xo
Becoming strong, healthy, and happy is what I want for you. It only takes one workout to begin transforming, and make me proud.
You and your Gym Girl Goddess are going to get this done. It’s not about pushing as hard as you can, it’s about being consistency. I want you to return to workout because you crave the endorphin rush and encouragement, not just the workout.
I want you strong, healthy, and happy…but most of all, I want you to be mine.
I’m never this sweet, except when you’re working out for me. Savor it, beta. xoxo
author: Goddess Nichole
